targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: 2026-05-27 (V3-EXQ-591 failure_autopsy): Substrate-uniform FAIL -- all 3 arms hit only 1/7 gate criteria across all 5 seeds (only C3 residue_cov, which saturates to 1.0 trivially in every arm). Curriculum scheduler stuck in Phase 0 across all 5 seeds (advancement gate H_pos >= 0.70*ln(144) ~= 3.48 vs observed rolling-mean H_pos 0.03-1.08). z_goal collapses to ~1e-7 in every arm. C5 harm/benefit ratio, C6 post-sleep retention, C7 traj cosine all return -1.0 'no data' sentinels in every seed of every arm (3 of 4 advisory criteria carry no information). ARM_1 and ARM_2 produce per-seed-identical rolling H_pos because Phase-0 env config = ARM_1 minimal config. Convergent shape with V3-EXQ-540a/b/c/e (MECH-307 / MECH-295 default-value recalibration), V3-EXQ-603 / 603b (training-regime measurement_gap), V3-EXQ-590a (Goldilocks novelty no-op) -- one structural property across four structurally-different claims. evidence_direction overridden to non_contributory; pending_retest_after_substrate=true. Does NOT weaken ARC-046. Retest gated on (a) MECH-307 default-value recalibration validated (V3-EXQ-540e PASS), (b) goal-pipeline training regime producing non-trivial z_goal in default config (V3-EXQ-603c P0/P1 phased training), (c) InfantCurriculumScheduler Phase 0->1 advancement signal tuned to achievable H_pos magnitudes OR replaced with a z_goal-norm-based / residue-progression-based exit gate.

learning_extracted: InfantCurriculumScheduler Phase 0 -> 1 advancement gate (H_pos >= 0.70 * ln(grid_cells) ~= 3.48) is structurally unreachable under random-policy 2000-episode training; rolling-mean H_pos saturates at ~1.08.
C3 (residue_coverage > 0.15) is degenerate as a discrimination criterion -- saturates to 1.0 trivially in every arm regardless of agent behaviour.

C5 / C6 / C7 carry no information at all -- 3 of 4 advisory criteria emit -1.0 'no data' sentinels in every seed of every arm. The full 7-criterion gate has only 3 potentially-discriminating criteria (C1, C2, C4), and all 3 depend on z_goal / H_pos developing.

ARM_1 minimal-flat and ARM_2 curriculum produce per-seed byte-identical rolling H_pos -- because ARM_2 never leaves Phase 0 and Phase 0 env config is the ARM_1 minimal config. The arm structure is degenerate under the current advancement gate.

V3 substrate at default config under standard random-policy training across 2000 episodes does not produce non-trivial z_goal -- same structural property observed in V3-EXQ-540a/b/c/e (MECH-307 / MECH-295), V3-EXQ-603 / 603b (training-regime), V3-EXQ-590a (Goldilocks no-op). One structural property across four structurally-different claims with four different downstream consumers.
